🫃 How the game works

Tap anywhere outside to close

Bladder-o-meter

The bar next to 🫃 is your bladder. It drains steadily from the moment you start hunting. Below a quarter you'll get Code Yellow warnings; hit zero and you lose your streak (and your dignity). Reach the loo before it empties.

⭐
Relief Points

Arrive at a loo to bank points: 100 minus 6 per minute taken, plus a bonus for how full the meter still was, plus 15 if the app spotted you arriving by GPS. Minimum 10. Points and your streak are saved on this phone.

🔥
Streak

Each loo reached before the meter hits zero adds one. Running dry resets it.

🧭
Arrow & mini map

The floor arrow and dots follow the walking route from OpenStreetMap. The little map bottom-left turns with you; tap it for the full route and turn-by-turn.

🚻
Loos

Public toilets plus pubs, cafés, shops and libraries that let people in. "ask" means it's customers-only in theory, so ask nicely. Hours and access change; the data is live from OpenStreetMap.
